topic: Universal tiered helper touches with visible field and health impact
currentUserGoal: Make every helper activation count as automation touches, with stronger later helpers, Memory scaling, and clear animated impact on the field and Ancient HP.
workCompleted: Added a universal automated-touch contract to every helper recipe instead of special-casing individual outputs.
Set the base touches-per-activation ladder to Tiny Sprinkler 1, Field Mouse 2, Bee Hive 3, Chicken Patrol 5, Earthworm Crew 8, Ancient Roots 13, Sheep Loop 21, and Meadow Rabbit 34.
Made every completed helper activation award Run Touches, advance the field, and restore Ancient HP.
Made helper copies and Speed Memories increase activation frequency.
Reframed the compatible efficiency rank as Impact: each rank adds 15 percent automated touches, 12 percent healing per touch, and retains 6 percent recipe input savings.
Added aggregate automation-touch and automation-healing totals and live rates to runtime state, readouts, summaries, saves, the semantic DOM, and browser debug data.
Kept old active-run saves compatible by defaulting the new additive snapshot fields to zero.
Added live automation touches-per-second to the header, equipment rows, helper badges, Ecosystem Works, and accessible control descriptions.
Added per-activation touch and healing projections to Impact Memory descriptions.
Added bounded field-impact rings, automated-touch feedback, grass-touch audio, a pooled restorative mote traveling toward the HP bar, and HP or Aegis heartbeat feedback.
Kept simulation aggregate and presentation pooled so higher helper counts do not create one actor or particle per automated touch.
Updated the durable ecosystem design document and corrected stale first-sprinkler, Field Mouse cache, and Remembered Touch values.
verificationRun: Focused Ecosystem System and Save tests passed: 68 tests.
npm run check passed: ESLint, 210 Vitest tests across 24 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop browser verification began from a clean Run 1 with zero helpers and zero automated touches.
A controlled later run verified two Tiny Sprinklers producing 5.1072 automated touches per second, Run Touches, effective healing, field-stage progress, and Aegis gain.
The animation harness observed three bounded active effects and a live Aegis gain pulse during a sprinkler activation.
The 390x844 phone pass retained the 5.1072 touches-per-second rate, bounded visible objects, approximately 143 sampled FPS, and zero frame spikes.
Browser diagnostics contained only normal Vite and Phaser startup messages, with no errors or warnings.
git diff --check passed with only expected Windows line-ending notices.
knownIssues: The exact touch and healing ladder still needs hands-on progression balance across real helper tiers.
The internal permanent-state field remains named efficiencyRanks for save compatibility even though the player-facing Memory is now Impact.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this slice.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test whether the first Tiny Sprinkler becomes meaningful quickly enough without replacing manual touch play.
Tune Speed and Impact prices against observed survival and field-expansion pacing.
Add helper-specific audiovisual variants as each later helper enters live progression.
doNotRevert: Do not make helper touches cosmetic-only; every completed helper cycle must update the aggregate model.
Do not restore recipe-specific Run Touch payouts for only Mouse or Chicken.
Do not loop once per automated touch or create effects proportional to large helper counts.
Do not rename the serialized efficiencyRanks field without an explicit save migration.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
